claims.text: Nusantara Olefins announced the mechanical completion of the Cilegon Cracker 1 expansion in March 2026, returning the unit to service with an ethylene capacity of 1,200 kta.

citations.quote: Following the expansion, the company describes the unit as having an ethylene capacity of 1,200 kta.

claims.text: The Cilegon Cracker 1 expansion involved replacing four cracking furnaces and upgrading the quench section during a planned 45-day turnaround.

citations.quote: The expansion replaced four cracking furnaces and upgraded the quench section. The company said the project was executed during a planned 45-day turnaround.

claims.text: Mekong Chemical Industries revised the expected startup of its Vung Tau steam cracker from 2027 to 2028 due to delayed delivery of the cracked gas compressor and slower progress on the marine offloading facility.

citations.quote: Mekong Chemical Industries has revised the expected startup of its Vung Tau steam cracker from 2027 to 2028.

claims.text: The Vung Tau steam cracker is designed for an ethylene capacity of 750 kta, with this figure unchanged following the schedule revision.

citations.quote: Mekong said the ethylene design capacity of 750 kta is unchanged.

claims.text: Selat Kimia Berhad declared force majeure on ethylene deliveries from its Pengerang complex in April 2026 due to corrosion identified during a scheduled turnaround, extending the outage beyond the planned duration.

citations.quote: Selat Kimia Berhad has declared force majeure on ethylene deliveries from its Pengerang complex with immediate effect. The company said inspection during the current scheduled turnaround identified corrosion in a quench tower internal that requires replacement, extending the outage beyond the planned duration.

claims.text: Selat Kimia Berhad stated that the force majeure and associated repairs at Pengerang are not expected to affect the unit's nameplate ethylene capacity once complete.

citations.quote: The company said it does not expect the work to affect nameplate capacity once complete.

claims.text: The ASEAN Petrochemical Monitor attributes the April 2026 ethylene supply peak to concurrent outages: the extended Pengerang turnaround and the tail of the Cilegon furnace replacement programme.

citations.quote: The Monitor attributes the April peak principally to concurrent supply outages: a planned turnaround at Pengerang, which the operator extended into a force majeure declaration, overlapping with the tail of the Cilegon furnace replacement programme in March.

claims.text: Both the Pengerang and Cilegon units returned to service by May and June 2026, easing supply constraints in the region.

citations.quote: Assessments eased through May and June as both units returned.

claims.text: Luzon Resins Corporation reported stable operations at its Batangas cracker for the year, with no unplanned outages and no restatement of capacity figures.

citations.quote: Luzon Resins Corporation reported stable operations across its Batangas complex for the year, with no unplanned outages at the cracker. Capacity figures were not restated in this summary.

claims.text: Meridian Petrochemicals confirmed both Jurong Island steam crackers operated at full rates through the fourth quarter of 2025, with a combined ethylene capacity of 1,450 kta.

citations.quote: Meridian states that its combined ethylene capacity across the two units is 1,450 kta.

claims.text: Selat Kimia Berhad started up a 380 kta HDPE line at its Pengerang complex in September 2025, taking ethylene from the existing cracker; this is a downstream development and does not affect cracker capacity.

citations.quote: Selat Kimia Berhad has started up a 380 kta HDPE line at its Pengerang complex. The line uses slurry loop technology and takes ethylene from the existing Pengerang cracker.

gaps.subject: Coral Bay Olefins (Sungai Liang Cracker) ethylene capacity
gaps.detail: The ethylene capacity of the Sungai Liang Cracker in Brunei is not publicly confirmed in the plant register or recent documents.

coverage_note: All major recent capacity changes, expansions, delays, and operational events affecting ethylene crackers in Southeast Asia are covered by company press releases and industry bulletins from the past year. No evidence of cancellations or debottleneckings was found in the retrieved documents. Capacity figures are only included where publicly confirmed.
